tests: Existing suites plus timed D3/renderer motion tests and pure controller/preload integration tests pass. Coverage includes exact parent-camera restoration, transition starts/intermediate/final positions, native reel frame handoff, DOM-ready activation without waiting on full load, three-view reuse, no reload on cached back/next, stale-load cancellation, preload watch-history correctness, screenshot failure fallback, and cleanup. Native GUI rendering remains unverified in this environment. Reels filter tests cover the unchanged default feed, exact source membership, multi-select scopes, apply/cancel drafts, keyboard Escape, native overlay, URL restoration, search, empty states, and scoped recommendation exhaustion. Playback shortcut tests cover app/native focus, key repeat, modifier keys, search typing, state synchronization without echo or reload, speed changes, and Restart. Manual takeover and resume tests cover drag-before-frame detection, preload IPC, background sender rejection, same-reel pause preservation, next/previous automatic playback, cached activation, and resume without paused-time catch-up. Explore search checks cover no filtering while typing, name ranking, Enter/click/arrow selection, empty results, Escape dismissal without clearing group, compatible/conflicting facets, off-page company reveal, selected URL restoration, coordinate-free list fallback, and timed centering motion.
